ledger: hand and number blocks | hand grasps first block on table at 00:00 | hand taps second block on left at 00:09 | hand repeats identical tilting gesture across the row from 00:00 to 00:07 as blocks appear without being fetched, then reverses direction from 00:07 to 00:09

findings.description: The hand performs a repetitive, looping tilt gesture from 00:01 to 00:07 while sliding right, causing new blocks to appear in sequence without the hand ever reaching to fetch or place them.
After moving right to the end of the row at 00:07, the hand abruptly shifts leftward across the middle blocks doing disconnected tapping motions without a continuous reach trajectory.
